instruction: The cells are oversized. Zoom out and bold all header cells in row 4 (columns C through H), then save.

llm_judge_reasons: Both instruction requirements (zoom out AND bold C4:H4) are now fully covered by the evaluator after the applied fixes.
Getter correctly reads ws.sheet_view.zoomScale from the saved xlsx to verify zoom-out. LibreOffice persists zoomScale in the xlsx sheetView XML when saving, making this a reliable check.
Metric combines zoom check (0.4 weight: zoom_scale < 200) and bold check (0.6 weight: fraction of 6 cells with explicit font.bold=True). Weights are semantically appropriate for the task.
Negative control resistance is strong: initial file state has zoom=200 and no explicit bold on C4:H4, giving score 0.0. Partial completions score proportionally (bold-only: max 0.6; zoom-only: 0.4).
Bold check uses 'is True' comparison which correctly distinguishes explicitly-bold (True) from inherited/unset (None) formatting.
zoom_scale default of 200 in result.get('zoom_scale', 200) is conservative — prevents false positives if key is missing.
Postconfig runs ctrl+s before evaluation ensuring the file reflects the agent's changes. Getter reads from the saved file.
Minor: the 'expected' parameter ({require_bold: true}) is not used by the metric, but this does not cause runtime errors and the hardcoded logic fully covers the task requirements.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: No critical fixes required. Optionally document in the metric docstring that the 'expected' parameter is unused (hardcoded thresholds are used instead).
If the original zoom of the xlsx file is ever not 200%, the check 'zoom_scale < 200' could be made more robust by storing the initial zoom in the expected rules and comparing against it.

metadata.capability_extraction: Can zoom in/out via menu, select cell ranges, apply formatting via toolbar or keyboard shortcuts
metadata.explanation: Task requires zooming out from the original 200% zoom AND selecting C4:H4 to apply bold formatting, then saving. Evaluator getter reads both ws.sheet_view.zoomScale and font.bold for each header cell from the saved xlsx. Metric combines zoom check (0.4 weight: zoom_scale < 200) and bold check (0.6 weight: fraction of 6 cells that are explicitly bold). An agent that only bolds without zooming scores at most 0.6; an agent that only zooms without bolding scores at most 0.4. Full score (1.0) requires both sub-goals. [Fixed: added zoom_scale check to getter and metric to cover the zoom-out requirement stated in the instruction.]

scoring_breakdown.zoom_out: 0.4 - zoom_scale < 200 (original was 200%, agent must zoom out)
scoring_breakdown.bold_cells: 0.6 * (bold_count / 6) - each of 6 header cells (C4:H4) that is explicitly bold contributes 0.1

fix_history: Fix 1: Updated getter to also return zoom_scale from ws.sheet_view.zoomScale (0 = LibreOffice default = 100%).

Fix 3: Added data_only=True to openpyxl.load_workbook per evaluator best practices.
